## How can I use it?

The data set is in plain text format and comes with a split annotation for training and evaluation. We provide the code to preprocess this text into JSON format so that you can apply your own NLP techniques to it.

### Preprocess

Preprocessing the data can be done with our [bash script](preprocess.sh). It will convert the raw text in `data` folder into a standard JSON format in `processed` using bash, jq and Python 3.

For this script to run on your machine you need to install jq e.g. via `sudo apt-get install jq`. (If you are not familiar with jq please check out [its documentation](https://stedolan.github.io/jq/manual/).)

### Use

After preprocessing, you can import the dataset into a huggingface hub repo using:

```
transformers-cli repo create your_repo_name
cd your_repo_name
mv ../processed/* .
git add *
git commit -m"Initial commit"
git push
